waybackify cache remediate [flags]

Refetch wrapper-stub captures raw

Sweep a cache root for captures the archive answered with its own
viewer page instead of the content — `interstitial` sidecars with
signature wrapper-stub or extension-mismatch. Each is refetched raw
(the id_ replay flag) and recommitted; the interstitial checks run
again on the new bytes. No ledger: the root's own sidecars are the
worklist. A stub that was already fetched raw, and every other
interstitial signature, needs a different capture — reported as
`repick`, never touched.

Output: one JSONL row per interstitial sidecar on stdout
({key, outcome: fixed | still | unavailable | deferred | repick});
a summary on stderr. Exit 0 when nothing was deferred, 1 when a
re-run has work left (429/5xx, or the sweep stopped on a throttle).

Flags:
  --root|-r <root>       cache root to sweep — required
  --delay-ms <n>         pacing between refetches (default 3000)
  --throttle-after <n>   consecutive deferrals before stopping (default 6; 0 = never)
  --max <n>              cap refetches this run (default: no cap)
  --dry-run              list what would be refetched; fetch nothing
  --help|-h              Show help

part of the wayback mirror tooling
